description: Real data: ENCODE H3K4me3 ChIP-seq in unstimulated mouse bone-marrow-derived macrophages, C57BL/6J (ENCSR916IRY, Hoffmann lab; file ENCFF813FPW, replicated peaks, mm10), the 800 strongest peaks. H3K4me3 marks active promoters, so nearly every peak should sit on a TSS and the gene set should read as macrophage identity and housekeeping genes. Good test of the promoter window and gene-set choice; motif scans on a broad mark are not very informative.
